note: MD of Taber campground in the Oldman River valley, 4 km north of Taber on Hwy 864, on a 60-acre park with shaded sites, free firewood, camp kitchens, a playground, ball diamonds, disc golf and the Coulee trail system; weekend security. Park office 11 am to 8 pm; gates 7 am to 9 pm (top gate open 24-7). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the MD of Taber page and Let's Camp: C$40 a night, 84 30 A power sites (72 bookable online, 5 pull-throughs, 25-110 ft), 4 first-come single-night sites; showers, washrooms, pit toilets, potable water, dump. Season not stated (page gives the park office as May-October); left as stored. Not waterfront confirmed; pin ~280 m off on the wrong side of Hwy 864.
flags: PIN (49.81170,-112.17380): in the trees WEST of Hwy 864, where there is no campground. The loops are east of the highway, south of the bridge; Let's Camp's own point 49.81237535941363,-112.17003213642411 is inside them. Recommend moving the pin to 49.81238,-112.17003 (~280 m east).

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): the northernmost loop pads are ~130-160 m south of the Oldman River behind a treed band and a gravel/sand floodplain. The page's 'Nestled along the serene banks of the Oldman River' does not put sites on the water.

SEASON: the stored approximate 05-01/10-31 (derived from note prose) was left alone: the page states no campground season, only 'Park office (May to October): 1-403-223-0091; Administration office (November to April): 1-403-223-3541' and winter skating/tobogganing.

PHONE: 403-223-0091 confirmed (park office May-October); administration November-April 1-403-223-3541. Websites: both stored URLs answered 200 and are this campground (the page also offers mdpark@mdtaber.ab.ca).

SITES: the page says 84 power stalls; Let's Camp lists 72 individual sites (numbers 1-81 with gaps) plus groups A, B, C; the page holds 4 for first-come. Wrote 84 (operator's figure). Max 110 ft (site 80, a pull-through) is Let's Camp's own figure.
GOOGLE: not looked up (municipal, not private).
